context:
Goal: every mod you run shows up where you work, or is gone.
Problem (goal): two of the seven mods do not work where you use them; only you know whether you still want what they show.
Based on (read): token-weather draws only above the prompt, a surface the host raises in the terminal only (mods types file, line 8285), so it never shows in the Claude app. You recall seeing it before, likely in a terminal session.
Based on (measured): session-board's Stop hook is skipped this session, because the plugin cc-plugin-sec-default handles the event first.

The other five stay: plain-diff, decision-watch, ponytail, frontend-design, and desktop-statusline (kept on a condition).

options.gain: You see context fill and the session board in the app.
options.how: A lane moves the context reading to a surface the app shows, and makes session-board run beside the other Stop plugin.
options.label: Fix both
options.lose: One more lane, and the band may need a different look in the app.

options.gain: One less mod to keep up; the session board works.
options.how: Remove token-weather; a lane fixes session-board only.
options.label: Fix session-board, drop token-weather
options.lose: No context-fill band anywhere, the terminal included.

options.gain: No fix lane; less to load in each session.
options.how: Remove both mods and their tests.
options.label: Drop both
options.lose: No context band and no session board.

ref: mods-relevance-review (keep, fix or drop each mod); mods token-weather (context band) and session-board (session list)
title: Fix or drop the context band and the session board?
why: You said you have seen the band and want it; the context bar is the one place your context fill shows (owner ruling Oct 14 in the mod's SOURCE.md).
